titulo: Cop31 live: draft climate deal calls for faster shift away from fossil fuels
cuerpo: ‘Cancer of indifference’ to climate crisis is pushing the world closer to the brink, says Mia Mottley as UN talks enter second week Chris Bowen, Australia’s climate minister and president of the negotiations, has opened a press conference by saying it “is a given” that parties will not agree on all elements of the draft. He added that the timing of this Cop – alongside the rise of AI, war and cost of living crises, among others – made it more important to show that multilateralism works. “The world wants us to act on climate change. As I’ve said before, this Cop meets at a time of polycrisis.” A draft of the cover decision, the formal text tying together the summit’s outcomes, has just been released. Diplomats, journalists, activists and scientists are currently poring over it. We’ll provide expert analysis shortly. Continue reading...
